integration: Add pub mod blast_effective_lengths in src/core/mod.rs; also expose blast_protein_matrix and blast_stat_gapped.
BlastEffectiveLengthsOptions and BlastEffectiveLengthsParameters are scoped owned types in this module; constructors and search-space override selection are implemented.
EffectiveLengthScoringOptions is the five-field scoring view: gapped_calculation, reward, penalty, gap_open, gap_extend. Populate from the standard scoring options.
Call blast_calc_eff_lengths with the score block/query info plus explicit matrix_name (None for nucleotide, Some(b"BLOSUM62") for default tblastn).
The optional Vec<BlastEffectiveLengthWarning> retains warning text and original context indexes.
No shared fields are needed for standard non-PSSM nucleotide/tblastn; a future PSSM implementation must distinguish kbp_gap_std from its alias.
